items.prompt: Which handover statement is supported after the supplied local contract tests pass?

options.text: The validator is proven safe for every real exchange feed
options.why: Real feed framing and deployment are outside scope.

options.text: No production system will ever reject a valid trade
options.why: Finite tests cannot establish that universal claim.

options.text: CSV quoted-field parsing has been fully implemented
options.why: The task starts from parsed dictionaries.

options.text: The specified local checks passed under the recorded runtime
options.why: This reports executed evidence without extending its scope.

items.explanation: State the actual test scope and runtime. Passing these local checks does not establish production readiness, parsing coverage or universal correctness.
